tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every screen, deck and document.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, chat transcripts and anything that sits on the page.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised or inset areas inside a card: code blocks, table headers, hover rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card outlines. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface-000, surface-100 and surface-200 (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, table metadata on any surface (5.7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Timestamps, placeholders and mono labels on any surface (4.9:1 or better). Never for sentences.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand blue as text and marks: links, focus rings, active states, key figures. Reads on every surface (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: accent-fill
tokens.usage: Background of the primary button and selected chips. Pair with on-accent text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-fill (5.3:1 dark, 6.7:1 light).

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: The warm off-white accent: the ground of a light section inside a dark page, print stock, the cover's relief block. Text on it is always ink-on-bone.

tokens.name: ink-on-bone
tokens.usage: Text on bone, in either theme.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered, connected, healthy. Text or icon on any surface; always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, disconnected, destructive. Text or icon on any surface; always with a word or icon, never colour alone.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero statements and the wordmark. One per page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings in the UI and in documents.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We design, build and operate WhatsApp agents that answer your customers with your own knowledge.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, metadata. Set in uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gaps between form fields.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between content blocks within a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between page sections. Be generous: whitespace reads as confidence.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, tags, code blocks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, dialogs. The largest radius for rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only. Never pill-shaped buttons.
